parsed.why: No trans criminalisation, no documented targeting or facility rules, but conservative climate, invisible gay culture, no SO/GI constitutional protection, no gender recognition, thin visitor record.
Sustained police harassment, detention and public humiliation of gender-nonconforming people without charge; lethal violence with police impunity; sodomy statute plus zero recourse for visitors.

Documented law-enforcement mistreatment/torture of LGBTQ people and false-accusation arrests, entrenched stigma forcing concealment, no anti-discrimination law, no gender recognition, no organisations or recourse.

Hate-crime and hate-speech coverage for trans identity, functioning prosecutions, no criminalisation; offset by a chain-wide changing-room ban reaching ordinary facilities and organised political hostility.

Strong anti-discrimination law and gender recognition, but protections rarely enforced, documented Pride violence, NGOs call anti-LGBTIQ violence prevalent and under-reported, thin institutional recourse.
